summary_ja: 内部評価方式の承認を受けた内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社が、申請事項の変更や承認基準不適合の事由が生じた場合に金融庁長官へ届け出る義務を定める。
summary_en: Requires an approved internal-assessment user to notify the Commissioner without delay of changes to its application or of grounds for non-conformity with the approval standards, and to submit an improvement plan in the latter case.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that has obtained approval for the use of the internal assessment approach shall, in any of the following cases, notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency of that fact and its details without delay: (i) where there is a change in the matters stated in the written application for approval; (ii) where there is a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the written application for approval; (iii) where grounds arise for non-conformity with the approval standards.

Where making a notification under item (iii) of the preceding paragraph, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall submit a plan for improvement regarding the grounds for non-conformity with the approval standards, either simultaneously with that notification or promptly after it.
